2105-4068-5144-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-4068-5144-8330.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Mountain.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-4068-5144-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Ephemerate from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Ephemerate from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

4279-6026-6634--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-6026-6634--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers, Field of Souls and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Field of Souls ability, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.

1168-1479-2841-8101.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.

Fetch a land using Wooded Foothills.

Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Toggo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Toggo from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Toggo triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat.

1170-1477-5131-7052--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-1477-5131-7052--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Savvy Trader.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature
Repeat.

215-1526-7296.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures.
215-1526-7296.description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Circle of Dreams Druid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Circle of Dreams Druid by paying its mana cost.

2104-7487-7631.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Zealous Lorecaster
When the Zealous Lorecaster token enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

240-2292-5929.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Leyline of Transformation, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-2292-5929.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

772-3175-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Repeat.

891-2921-2961.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, False Demise triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Repeat.

240-3967-5470-6633.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

1402-2644-4763-7292.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Sai of the Shinobi triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

413-1765-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
413-1765-5972.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

539-560-3007-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Toymaker.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

2440-3399-4399-6720.description:
Cast Stormfront Riders by paying {4}{W/P} due to Defiler of Faith.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Mana Echoes and Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Soldier you control.
Resolve the Case of the Uneaten Feast trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Stormfront Riders spell. When it enters, it, Mana Echoes and Case of the Uneaten Feast trigger.
Resolve the Case of the Uneaten Feast trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Stormfront Riders trigger, returning it and the Soldier token created in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Stormfront Riders' second ability triggers twice.
Resolve a Stormfront Riders trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 one additional time.
Repeat from step 10 for the remaining trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger from step 6, adding {C} for each Soldier you control.
Repeat.

Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Marwyn.

Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Dragon Appeasement triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Goblin Bombardment abilities.
Repeat.

560-2457-5794-6441.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect and two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the Soldier and Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1357-3584-4697.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least two mana producing permanents, one of which can tap to produce at least {U}.
You've cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
1357-3584-4697.description:
Cast Reality Spasm by paying at least {3}{U}{U}, targeting at least three permanents and choosing the untap mode.
Thousand-Year Storm triggers, copying Reality Spasm at least once, targeting at least three permanents.
Holding priority, activate at least two mana-producing permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Errant by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, copying the Reality Spasm copy, targeting Errant and at least two mana-producing permanents you control.
Resolve the copy of Reality Spasm from step 3, untapping Errant and at least two mana-producing permanents you control.
Repeat from step 3.
1357-3584-4697.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} extra when casting Reality Spasm initially. If you choose not to, you will not get infinite untap of permanents or mana from those permanents, unless one of the mana-producing permanents taps to produce two or more mana.

643-3951-4094-5703.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

539-2034-5003-6517.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ashaya, adding {C}{C}.
When Ashaya dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Ashaya enters the battlefield, Dragonback Assault triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
If you control a nontoken creature that has haste, you may instead sacrifice it, and then tap it each iteration to get infinite green mana and colorless mana.

When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Repeat.

413-586-5626-5687.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing the Eldrazi Spawn and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger, adding {B}{B}{B} and untapping Blasting Station.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

1636-5010-5256-5615.notablePrerequisites: The Master does not have summoning sickness.
1636-5010-5256-5615.description:

Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill Golgari Thug from your library.
Activate The Master by tapping it, putting Golgari Thug from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Thug enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

Master of the Veil and Blasting Station trigger.

Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.

When Dance of the Dead enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
Repeat.

1308-2178-4214-4312.notablePrerequisites:
Utopia Mycon has at least three spore counters on it.
Thornbite Staff attached to Vorel of the Hull Clade.
Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
1308-2178-4214-4312.description:
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Utopia Mycon.
Activate Utopia Mycon's first ability by removing three spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Utopia Mycon's second ability twice by sacrificing the Saprolings, adding {G}{U}.
When the Saporlings die, Vorel of the Hull Clade triggers twice, untapping it.
Repeat.
If Utopia Mycon has four or more spore counters on it to begin the combo, this combo nets infinite spore counters on Utopia Mycon, which you may remove for infinite Saproling tokens and/or colored mana, or target another creature using Vorel of the Hull Clade.

Myr Moonvessel triggers, adding {C}.
